about:
I'm an Android Developer with a background in Electrical & Electronics Engineering (class of 2022). I build polished, production-ready Android apps using Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, and modern architecture patterns like MVVM and Clean Architecture.

Beyond Android, I'm passionate about Kotlin Multiplatform for sharing business logic across platforms, and I've extended my skills into IntelliJ plugin development with SmartCodeSorter.
